name: Malevolent Reflections

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-14: Shattering Golden Chains

disable: DC 27 Stealth check (trained) to approach a mirror without showing up in the reflection, followed by DC 25 Thievery check to cover mirror or dispel magic (3nd level; counteract DC 25) to counteract the binding

items.name: Release Rakshasa
items.text:
Trigger The mirror breaks

---

Effect The mirror releases a Dandasuka rakshasa. The raktavarna rolls initiative and remains for 3 rounds, after which the spell ends and the rakshasa disappears. The summoned raktavarna can use 3 actions each round and can use reactions, unlike most summoned creatures.

items.name: Fiend's Luck
items.text:
Trigger Fasiel is within 100 feet, this is the closest intact wicked reflections hazard, and a hostile creature's action would cause Fasiel to gain the Blinded, Confused, controlled, Fascinated, Immobilized, Paralyzed, petrified, Restrained, slowed, stunned, or Unconscious condition or would deal 20+ damage to Fasiel

---

Effect The mirror breaks and disrupts the action.

text: Ornate full-length mirrors with fiendish filigree depict the image of Fasiel ibn Sazadin in villainous triumph over his enemies.
